necessary_context.content: Nonempty closed convex X subset R^m and Y subset R^n (p.1); both bounded in the convex-concave setting (p.5). Euclidean norm, projections P_X,P_Y and diameters D_x,D_y (p.4). Joint gradient Lipschitz constant ell (Definition 2); block strong convexity/concavity (Definition 3); kappa_x=ell/mu_x and kappa_y=ell/mu_y. Definition 4 uses max_y f(xhat,y)-min_x f(x,yhat)<=epsilon.
